name: taxiway_width_m
meaning: Paved width of a taxiway (ICAO code E is about 23 m). The taxiway area is the centerline buffered by half this width. ASSUMPTION

name: taxilane_width_m
meaning: Paved width of an apron taxilane. ASSUMPTION

name: gnss_tolerance_m
meaning: Extra margin around taxiway areas for GPS noise (typically 3-10 m). Points inside this margin are not flagged. ASSUMPTION

name: corridor_length_m
meaning: How far each approach corridor extends out from the runway end (guide: 15-20 km). ASSUMPTION

name: corridor_half_angle_deg
meaning: How fast the corridor widens on each side (guide: 5-10 deg). ASSUMPTION

name: corridor_start_half_width_m
meaning: Half-width of the corridor at the runway end (ICAO approach surface inner edge is about 300 m wide). ASSUMPTION

name: taxiway_max_speed_kt
meaning: Max taxi speed on straight taxiways (guide: 20-30 kt). ASSUMPTION

name: taxilane_max_speed_kt
meaning: Max taxi speed on apron taxilanes. ASSUMPTION

name: service_road_max_speed_kmh
meaning: Max speed for vehicles on airside service roads. ASSUMPTION

name: apron_vehicle_speed_kmh
meaning: Max speed for ground vehicles on aprons (aprons layer speed_limit_kmh). ASSUMPTION

name: near_runway_vehicle_speed_kmh
meaning: Max speed for vehicles on a runway or inside its strip, only with ATC clearance (runways and runway_strip speed_limit_kmh). ASSUMPTION

name: parking_max_dwell_min
meaning: Max time a vehicle may stay in a restricted parking / staging area (restricted_parking max_dwell_min). ASSUMPTION

name: taxiway_area_vehicle_speed_kmh
meaning: Max speed for ground vehicles inside the taxiway area (taxiway_area speed_limit_kmh). ASSUMPTION

name: stand_vehicle_speed_kmh
meaning: Max speed for ground vehicles at an aircraft stand (stands speed_limit_kmh). ASSUMPTION

name: holding_area_vehicle_speed_kmh
meaning: Max speed for vehicles at a runway holding point / holding area (holding_points and runway_holding_area speed_limit_kmh). ASSUMPTION

name: fuel_zone_vehicle_speed_kmh
meaning: Max speed for vehicles inside a fuel station zone (sensitive_zones kind=fuel speed_limit_kmh). ASSUMPTION

name: parking_vehicle_speed_kmh
meaning: Max speed for vehicles inside restricted parking / staging areas (restricted_parking speed_limit_kmh). ASSUMPTION

name: holding_area_radius_m
meaning: Radius of the circle drawn around each runway holding point (runway_holding_area zones). ASSUMPTION

name: runway_strip_half_width_m
meaning: Runway strip width on each side of the centerline (ICAO code 4 instrument runway). ASSUMPTION

name: runway_strip_end_extension_m
meaning: How far the runway strip extends past each runway end (ICAO). ASSUMPTION
